name: Full-Stack Web Development
tagline: Build complete web apps — from the interface users see to the APIs and databases behind it.

overview.summary: Full-stack developers build both the front end (what users see and click, built with HTML, CSS, JavaScript/TypeScript and frameworks like React) and the back end (servers, APIs, authentication and databases). It is the most common entry path into software jobs and freelancing, and in 2026 it increasingly includes adding AI features — chat interfaces, smart search, summarisation — to ordinary web products.
whyTrending: JavaScript remains the most-used language among developers in the Stack Overflow Developer Survey 2025, and TypeScript usage keeps climbing in job listings.
Software and application developers appear on the WEF Future of Jobs Report 2025 list of fastest-growing jobs, and BLS projects 10% growth for software developers (2025–35).
AI coding tools changed the job rather than removing it: employers now want developers who can ship faster with AI, review generated code and build AI-powered features.
Web development is Bangladesh's most common entry into IT jobs and freelancing, with hundreds of thousands of active freelancers serving international clients.

beginner: CSS layout: Flexbox, Grid, responsive design
JavaScript fundamentals: variables, functions, arrays, objects, DOM, fetch
How the web works: HTTP, DNS, client vs server
intermediate: Tailwind CSS or another utility/component system
Node.js with Express, Fastify or Next.js API routes
SQL databases (PostgreSQL) and an ORM (Prisma or Drizzle)
advanced: Server components, caching and rendering strategies (SSR, SSG, ISR)
System design: scaling, queues, caching with Redis
Web security: OWASP Top 10, CSP, CSRF, XSS prevention
Performance optimisation and Core Web Vitals
Integrating LLM APIs with streaming responses

stack.note: React + TypeScript + Node.js + PostgreSQL is the most common combination in listings. In Bangladesh, PHP/Laravel and MERN stacks are still widely requested by agencies.

interview.question: What happens when you type a URL and press Enter?
interview.answer: DNS lookup, TCP/TLS connection, HTTP request, server response, then the browser parses HTML, loads CSS/JS, builds the DOM/CSSOM, lays out and paints the page.

interview.question: Explain the difference between let, const and var.
interview.answer: var is function-scoped and hoisted; let and const are block-scoped. const cannot be reassigned (though objects it holds can be mutated). Prefer const, then let.

interview.question: What is the virtual DOM / how does React update the UI?
interview.answer: React keeps a lightweight representation of the UI, compares (diffs) it after state changes and applies only the minimal real DOM updates needed.

interview.question: SSR vs CSR vs SSG?
interview.answer: Client-side rendering builds the page in the browser; server-side rendering builds HTML per request on the server; static generation builds HTML at build time. SSR/SSG improve SEO and first load.

interview.question: What is CORS?
interview.answer: A browser security mechanism that blocks cross-origin requests unless the server explicitly allows the requesting origin via response headers.

interview.question: REST vs GraphQL?
interview.answer: REST exposes resources at multiple endpoints with fixed responses; GraphQL exposes one endpoint where clients request exactly the fields they need. GraphQL reduces over-fetching but adds complexity.

interview.question: How do you store passwords securely?
interview.answer: Never store plain text. Hash with a slow, salted algorithm like bcrypt or Argon2, and use HTTPS everywhere.

interview.question: What is a database index?
interview.answer: A data structure that speeds up lookups on columns at the cost of extra storage and slower writes. Index columns used in frequent WHERE, JOIN and ORDER BY clauses.

interview.question: What is the event loop in JavaScript?
interview.answer: The mechanism that lets single-threaded JS handle async work: the call stack runs code, and completed async callbacks wait in task/microtask queues until the stack is empty.

interview.question: How would you improve a slow web page?
interview.answer: Measure first (Lighthouse, Web Vitals), then optimise images, reduce/split JS bundles, cache responses, use a CDN, lazy-load below-the-fold content and fix slow API queries.

demandNotes.bangladesh: High and the largest number of openings — agencies, startups, offshore firms and in-house teams all hire web developers. Competition at entry level is intense, so a strong portfolio matters.
demandNotes.remote: High volume but very competitive. TypeScript, React/Next.js and solid back-end skills plus good English help stand out.
demandNotes.global: High. Software development remains the largest tech job category; AI shifts expectations toward productivity and AI feature work rather than reducing demand overall.
